QuestInfo.name: Edea's Doubt
QuestInfo.0: #bEdea#k has finished planning the next battle, but she looks troubled.
QuestInfo.1: You can quickly move behind the enemy's front line using the Nova Royal Tunnels. Talk to #bEdea#k.
QuestInfo.2: You resolved to gather the enemy into one place by using their singals against them.

0.msg: I have a plan. The key to this battle will be luring them to one place, then destroying them with a single, mighty burst of magic.\r\n

1.msg: Kaiser will draw the enemy out, while Angelic Buster will provide rear support.\r\n

2.msg: I wish for you to disrupt their communications with explosives, but... there is a slight problem.\r\n

3.msg: The enemy uses explosive signals to quickly dispatch orders. That is why there are explosives piled up throughout Heliseum's forests.\r\n

4.msg: I would like to take advantage of these explosives, but they're spread too far apart. There's no way to detonate them all at once.\r\n

5.msg: I could send several squads to take care of this, but that will just draw attention to our plan. We will simply have to make due without...\r\n

6.msg: #b(The explosives are too far from each other when you have to deal with enemy soldiers, but you have a unique way around that problem...)#k\r\n

7.msg: #b(Your royal crest is the key. Volunteer to take care of the explosives for Edea.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(After all this time, you can finally put your secret lineage to use.)#k\r\n
#b(Wasn't there something urgent you had to do?)#k\r\n
#b(You're the only one with a royal crest. Tell Edea that you'll take care of the explosives.)#k\r\n
